value.rationale: An exact critical operator-theoretic spectral classification for a natural reverse product involving a compact and an unbounded factor. Unlike already-covered boundedness/compactness tests, the result determines the entire positive spectral and essential spectral intervals, spectral type, absence of eigenvalues, norm and essential norm for every c>1 and 0<tau<1 on the critical surface. This is a mathematically motivated phase-boundary phenomenon directly related to a stated unresolved reverse-product program; no downstream theorem is claimed.
